meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源限制并输出JSON快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要了解本地机器资源限制后再运行任务
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resource limits and output JSON snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know your local machine's resource limits before running tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在开始计算密集型任务前会先检测电脑的 CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘和系统信息,生成一份脱敏的 .claude_resources.json 快照,并给出并行处理、内存策略、GPU 加速等建议。
howto.when: 当用户提出资源感知规划或即将执行对资源敏感的本地任务(如大数据分析、模型训练、并行处理)时,会先检测资源。

say.text: 帮我检测一下当前电脑的资源情况。
say.note: 生成资源快照和策略建议。

say.text: 我要处理 50GB 的基因组数据,内存够吗?
say.note: 会检测内存,必要时推荐 Dask/Zarr。

say.text: 训练神经网络前,看看有没有可用的 GPU。
say.note: 检测 NVIDIA/AMD/Apple GPU 及后端。

howto.what_en: After install, before compute-heavy tasks, Claude detects CPU/GPU/memory/disk/OS, saves a redacted .claude_resources.json, and suggests parallel, memory, and GPU strategies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for resource-aware planning or is about to run a resource-sensitive local task, such as large-data analysis, model training, or parallel processing.

say_en.text: Check the current resource usage of this machine.
say_en.note: Creates a resource snapshot with recommendations.

say_en.text: I need to process 50GB of genomics data. Is there enough memory?
say_en.note: Checks memory and suggests Dask/Zarr if needed.

say_en.text: Before training a neural network, check for available GPUs.
